short_description: Matrix-style digital rain for your BUSY Bar, with falling green characters and fading trails.
description:
Code Rain brings the digital rain from *The Matrix* to your BUSY Bar’s 72×16 front display. Fourteen streams of mirrored katakana fall at different speeds, with bright green characters leading trails that fade into black.

Open **Code Rain** from the Apps menu and the animation starts right away. It runs offline. Press **Back** to exit.
